notes.title: Major Update 0.03
notes.content:
Hi, Survivor
It's been a while since the last update, so there's another update today, a few bugs were fixed and new functions were added.

[u][b]New [/b][/u]
-The second and third levels have been remade (all others will also be reworked in the next few weeks)
-New feature: A random loot spawner that generates new loot every round
-New Icon for the Weapons 
-New Menu

[u][b]Bug fixes:[/b][/u]
-Level 3 water didn't kill

[u][b]Discord[/b][/u]
We now also have a Discord server where you can report bugs or feedback. Or you can exchange ideas with the community!

Link to the Official Battle Rift Discord Server: https://discord.gg/tJAqErQxA6

notes.title: Patch 0.02
notes.content:
Hi, 

We listened to the community and made changes to the game. Have fun!

Fixes:

Level 5 font
In-game menu redesigned
Options button has changed to INFO button

We hope you like the game, we would be happy if you rate our game!
